question_text: A train leaves New Delhi for Mumbai. Five minutes later another train leaves Mumbai for New Delhi, with a speed double that of the train that left New Delhi for Mumbai. Which train will be closer to New Delhi when they meet?

options.label: c
options.text: Both will be at the same distance

options.label: d
options.text: Depends upon the speed of trains and total distance between New Delhi and Mumbai

explanation: When the two trains meet they are at the same point on the track, so at that instant both are exactly the same distance from New Delhi — regardless of their speeds. Option (c).
